snippet.title: 모모스커피 전주연 대표가 전하는 진짜 창업 이야기
snippet.description:
부산 온천장의 작은 4평 공간에서 시작해 전 세계가 주목하는 스페셜티 커피 브랜드가 되기까지! 
모모스커피 전주연 대표가 직접 들려주는 창업의 민낯과 철학을 담았습니다. 

성장의 정점에서 찾아온 정체성 혼란을 어떻게 극복했을까요?
단순한 구매를 넘어 상생을 고민하는 다이렉트 트레이드부터 바리스타와 로스터를 위한 꿈의 일터 탄생 비화까지! 

창업을 꿈꾸는 모든 분들께 전주연 대표가 전하는 진심 어린 조언을 확인하세요. 

#중소벤처기업부 #모모스커피 #전주연 #전주연대표 #바리스타 #스페셜티커피 #창업 #브랜딩 #부산커피 #바리스타챔피언

id.title: Kisah Nyata Startup oleh CEO Momos Coffee, Jeon Ju-yeon
id.description:
Dari ruang kecil seluas 4 pyeong di Oncheonjang, Busan, hingga menjadi merek kopi spesial global!

Kami telah menangkap realitas dan filosofi memulai bisnis yang sebenarnya, diceritakan langsung oleh CEO Momos Coffee, Jeon Ju-yeon.

Bagaimana ia mengatasi krisis identitas yang muncul di puncak pertumbuhannya?

Dari perdagangan langsung yang mempertimbangkan pertumbuhan bersama di luar sekadar pembelian, hingga kisah di balik layar kelahiran tempat kerja impian bagi barista dan peracik kopi!

Simak nasihat tulus yang ditawarkan CEO Jeon Ju-yeon kepada semua orang yang bermimpi memulai bisnis.

#MinistryOfSMEsAndStartups #MomosCoffee #JeonJuyeon #CEOJeonJuyeon #Barista #SpecialtyCoffee #Startup #Branding #BusanCoffee #BaristaChampion

en-US.title: The Real Startup Story by Momos Coffee CEO Jeon Ju-yeon
en-US.description:
From a small 4-pyeong space in Oncheonjang, Busan, to becoming a global specialty coffee brand!

We have captured the raw reality and philosophy of starting a business, told firsthand by Momos Coffee CEO Jeon Ju-yeon.

How did she overcome the identity crisis that arose at the peak of her growth?

From direct trade that considers mutual growth beyond simple purchasing, to the behind-the-scenes story of the birth of a dream workplace for baristas and roasters!

Check out the heartfelt advice CEO Jeon Ju-yeon offers to everyone dreaming of starting a business.

snippet.title: 26년 모태펀드 출자전략위원회
snippet.description:
26년 5월 14일(목), 
’26년 제2차 모태펀드 출자전략위원회」가 개최됐습니다 📈✨

이번 회의에서는
모태펀드의 운용 성과를 점검하고

업계·전문가·관계부처와 함께 공유했습니다 📊

두 번째 안건에서는
각 부처별 출자 현황과

“벤처투자의 마중물 역할을 더욱 강화해

id.title: Komite Strategi Investasi Dana Investasi Jangka Panjang 26 Tahun
id.description:
Pada hari Kamis, 14 Mei 2026, pertemuan ke-2 Komite Strategi Investasi Fund of Funds telah diadakan. 📈✨

Dalam pertemuan ini, kami meninjau kinerja operasional Fund of Funds dan membahas rencana investasi untuk tahun 2027 serta arah pengembangan di masa mendatang. 💬🤝

Untuk agenda pertama, kami berbagi pencapaian utama sejak peluncuran Fund of Funds dengan perwakilan industri, para ahli, dan kementerian terkait. 📊

Untuk agenda kedua, dilanjutkan dengan presentasi tentang status investasi masing-masing kementerian dan strategi investasi utama di masa mendatang. 🚀💡

“Kami akan semakin memperkuat peran kami sebagai katalisator investasi ventura untuk mendukung terciptanya perusahaan Big Tech dan perluasan ekosistem investasi.” 🌱

#FundOfFunds #VentureInvestment #Startup #BigTech #InvestmentEcosystem

en-US.title: Ministry of SMEs and Startups Wins 'Bronze Award' for Excellent Policy Promotion 🎉
en-US.description:
On May 8, 2026, the ‘New PR Wave: Rediscovering Policy Communication’ event was held at the National Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art, Seoul.

🎤✨

During the ‘Policy Communication K I Chose’ event held that day, presentations on excellent policy promotion cases from government ministries and on-site evaluations took place.

The Ministry of SMEs and Startups won the final Bronze Award, ranking 1st in the presentation evaluation and 3rd in the public evaluation for its project titled ‘Startup for All.’

“We will continue innovative policy communication that the public can truly experience.” 🌱💡

Go to the ‘Startup for All’ platform:

https://www.modoo.or.kr/

#PolicyCommunication #NewPRWave #MSIT #GovernmentPolicy #CommunicationInnovation #StartupForAll

id.description:
Pada hari Rabu, 13 Mei 2026, kami mengadakan pertemuan dengan para CEO dari 19 Pusat Inovasi Ekonomi Kreatif di seluruh negeri di Pusat Inovasi Ekonomi Kreatif Seoul.

Selama pertemuan, kami membahas kesulitan di lapangan dan langkah-langkah perbaikan terkait implementasi proyek ‘Startup untuk Semua’.

en-US.title: On-site meeting for childbirth and childcare support for female and young small business owners
en-US.description:
On Tuesday, May 12, 2026, the "Meeting on Childbirth and Childcare for Female and Young Small Business Owners" was held at FEAT.

During this meeting, discussions took place regarding the care gaps and management difficulties experienced while balancing childbirth, childcare, and running a livelihood.

In particular, we listened directly to the actual voices from the field operated by young couples running small businesses and discussed ways to reflect these in policy.

We will continue to strengthen the social safety net so that you can continue your livelihood with peace of mind while raising children.

#SmallBusinessOwners #ChildbirthAndChildcare #YouthStartup #SocialSafetyNet #FemaleSmallBusinessOwners

id.description:
Pada hari Selasa, 12 Mei 2026, "Pertemuan tentang Persalinan dan Pengasuhan Anak untuk Pemilik Usaha Kecil Perempuan dan Muda" diadakan di FEAT.

Selama pertemuan ini, diskusi berlangsung mengenai kesenjangan perawatan dan kesulitan manajemen yang dialami saat menyeimbangkan persalinan, pengasuhan anak, dan menjalankan mata pencaharian.

Secara khusus, kami mendengarkan langsung suara-suara nyata dari lapangan yang dioperasikan oleh pasangan muda yang menjalankan usaha kecil dan membahas cara untuk mencerminkan hal ini dalam kebijakan.

Kami akan terus memperkuat jaring pengaman sosial sehingga Anda dapat melanjutkan mata pencaharian Anda dengan tenang sambil membesarkan anak.

snippet.title: 4평에서 시작한 부산 커피 성지의 20년
snippet.description:
"여기가 스페셜티 커피의 성지가 됐으면 좋겠어요." 

단순히 커피를 파는 곳을 넘어, 
지역 주민들에게 '선물 같은 공간'이 되고 싶다는 진심. 
4평 남짓한 작은 식당 창고에서 시작해,
20년 동안 부산을 지켜온 모모스커피의 특별한 공간 이야기를 공개합니다.

건물 벽을 허물어 길을 만들고, 
낮은 바(Bar) 설계로 고객과 눈을 맞추는 이유. 
단순한 인테리어를 넘어
100년 기업을 꿈꾸는 대표님의 공간 철학을 만나보세요.

#스페셜티커피 #부산카페 #모모스커피 #전주연대표 #공간브랜딩 #카페창업 #커피성지 #로스터리 #인테리어 #중소벤처기업부 #중기부 #머니포자 #커피맛집

id.title: 20 Tahun Tanah Suci Kopi Busan, Dimulai pada 4 Pyeong
id.description:
"Saya berharap tempat ini menjadi kiblat kopi spesial."

Lebih dari sekadar menjual kopi, ini adalah keinginan tulus untuk menjadi "ruang seperti hadiah" bagi penduduk setempat.

Berawal dari gudang restoran kecil seluas lebih dari 4 pyeong,

kami mengungkap kisah istimewa Momos Coffee, tempat yang telah menjaga Busan selama 20 tahun.

Alasan di balik pembongkaran dinding bangunan untuk menciptakan jalur dan desain bar rendah agar dapat berinteraksi langsung dengan pelanggan.

Lebih dari sekadar desain interior,

temukan filosofi spasial dari CEO, yang bermimpi tentang perusahaan yang berumur 100 tahun.

en-US.title: 20 Years of Busan's Coffee Holy Land, Starting in 4 Pyeong
en-US.description:
"I hope this place becomes a mecca for specialty coffee."

Beyond simply selling coffee, it is a sincere desire to become a "gift-like space" for local residents.

Starting from a small restaurant warehouse of just over 4 pyeong,

we reveal the special story of Momos Coffee, a place that has stood guard over Busan for 20 years.

The reason for tearing down building walls to create pathways and designing low bars to make eye contact with customers.

Beyond simple interior design,

discover the spatial philosophy of the CEO, who dreams of a 100-year company.

snippet.description:
강원도행 ‘동행열차’ 출발합니다! 🚂💨

id.title: Kunjungan ke Pameran Penjualan Kesejahteraan Bersama Usaha Kecil Festival Donghaeng
id.description:
Pada hari Jumat, 1 Mei 2026, kami mengunjungi ‘Pameran Penjualan Saling Menguntungkan untuk Usaha Kecil’ yang diadakan di Starfield Anseong untuk mendorong para pemilik usaha kecil.

Menteri Kementerian Usaha Kecil dan Menengah serta Menteri Pertanian, Pangan, dan Urusan Pedesaan bersama-sama meninjau lokasi Festival Donghaeng dan menyampaikan pesan untuk meningkatkan konsumsi.

Kami berencana untuk memperkuat kerja sama guna memperluas peluang bagi pemilik usaha kecil untuk bertemu langsung dengan konsumen melalui kerja sama dengan ruang ritel besar, dan untuk memastikan hal ini menghasilkan pertumbuhan penjualan yang substansial.

Kami memohon agar Anda terus menunjukkan minat dan berpartisipasi dalam Festival Donghaeng, yang berlangsung hingga 10 Mei.

en-US.title: Visit to the Donghaeng Festival Small Business Co-prosperity Sales Exhibition
en-US.description:
On Friday, May 1, 2026, we visited the ‘Small Business Win-Win Sales Fair’ held at Starfield Anseong to encourage small business owners.

The Minister of the Ministry of SMEs and Startups and the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs inspected the site of the Donghaeng Festival together and delivered a message to boost consumption.

en-US.title: AI+ Policy Briefing
en-US.description:
In the era of AI, where does the new competitiveness of SMEs begin?

This video introduces the scene of the AI+ Policy Briefing.

Chief AI officials and experts from industry, academia, and research institutions gathered to discuss AI self-regulation, policy recommendations, administrative innovation based on public data, and AI support systems and business directions for SMEs.

In particular, the Ministry of SMEs and Startups and the Korea Technology Information Institute introduced key policies and projects that SMEs can utilize in the field, including AI support systems, smart factories, AI R&D, and smart services.

AI is no longer a technology of the distant future.

It is becoming a core tool for enhancing the productivity and competitiveness of SMEs in manufacturing, logistics, administration, and service sectors.

Check out the video to see the policy directions for the AI ​​transition of SMEs and the potential for change in the field.

📍 Event Name: AI+ Policy Briefing

📍 Main Contents

- Guide to Regulatory Responses to the Framework Act on AI

- Introduction to AI Support Systems for SMEs

- Introduction to Support Programs for Smart Factories, AI R&D, and Smart Services

snippet.title: #댓글이벤트│맛과 멋의 고장 투어! 🎢 광주·호남을 제대로 휩쓸고 온 동행열차의 기록
snippet.description:
압도적 몰입감!
롤러코스터를 타고 만나는 광주·호남의 보석 같은 풍경들 🚂✨
비주얼 아티스트 @ssestar_art님과 협업한 ‘동행열차’가
이번에는 광주.전라도로 달려갔습니다.

남원 광한루원의 고즈넉한 정취부터
익산 미륵사지의 장엄함,
보성 녹차밭의 싱그러움과
담양 죽녹원의 시원한 대나무 숲까지!
여기에 광주 동구의 명물 창억떡과 궁전제과,
함평천지 전통시장의 활기까지 가득 담았습니다. 🥯🌾

여러분의 가치 있는 소비 한 걸음이 지역 소상공인들에게 따뜻한 온기가 됩니다.
이번 봄, 대중교통을 이용해 호남의 매력을 직접 느껴보시는 건 어떨까요? 🤝💖

📅 축제 기간: 2026. 04. 11. ~ 05. 10.
🔗 동행축제 홈페이지: https://k-shoppingfesta.org/

📢 댓글 #이벤트
'광주∙전라도'에 가볼만한 맛집, 전통시장, 관광지를 댓글로 추천해주세요! 

🎁 추첨을 통해 커피 쿠폰을 선물로 드립니다! 
📌 이벤트 기간 : 5.06.(수) ~ 5.19.(화)
📌 이벤트 경품 : 커피 쿠폰 10명
📌 당첨자 발표 : 2026.5.22.(금)

✅ (완전중요) 참여 방법
1. 영상 좋아요와 채널 구독은 필수!
2. 댓글로 추천 장소 남기기!
3. 댓글 작성 후 아래 이벤트 참여 양식 작성 필수!
(https://forms.gle/2nm3bJbpBgSMem2q8)

협업채널 : @ssestar_art
*본 콘텐츠는 생성형 AI를 활용하여 제작한 영상입니다.

snippet.title: 바빠서 설명회 못 오신다고요? 그래서 준비했습니다! 💻
snippet.description:
"시간이 없어서, 멀어서 정책 소식 놓치지 마세요!" 🤝✨
현장 설명회에 오고 싶어도 생업 때문에 발걸음을 떼기 어려운 소상공인분들의 마음,
중기부가 잘 알고 있습니다. 
그래서 장관님이 직접 라이브 방송이라는 새로운 소통 채널을 선택했습니다!

실시간 질의응답은 물론, 언제든 다시 찾아볼 수 있는 녹화본까지!
현장의 목소리를 가장 빠르고 정확하게 정책에 담아내기 위한
장관님의 뜨거운 열정을 확인해 보세요. 🔥

여러분의 소중한 의견이 대한민국 경제의 지도가 됩니다. 🚀

en-US.title: Can't make it to the information session because you're busy? We've prepared something for you! 💻
en-US.description:
"Don't miss out on policy news just because you don't have time or live far away!" 🤝✨

The Ministry of SMEs and Startups understands the struggles of small business owners who want to attend on-site briefings but find it difficult to make the trip due to their livelihoods.

That is why the Minister has personally chosen a new communication channel: a live broadcast!

From real-time Q&A to recorded footage available for viewing anytime!

Check out the Minister's burning passion to incorporate voices from the field into policy as quickly and accurately as possible. 🔥

Your valuable opinions become the map of the Korean economy. 🚀

#MinistryofSMEsandStartups #MinisterHanSungSook #StartupsForEveryone #OnsiteAdministration #LocalStartups #Startups #Tongyeong #Jinju #Vlog #EconomyRevitalization #SupplementaryBudgetExecution

snippet.title: 현장에 가면 문제해결 실마리가 보입니다!
snippet.description:
서류상으로는 한참 걸릴 고민들이 현장에서 단번에 해결!
창업 중심 대학이자 로컬 콘텐츠 중점 대학인 경상국립대에서 미래의 CEO들을 만났습니다. 

학생들의 현실적인 고민을 듣고, 
총장님과 함께 '창업 휴학제' 개선 등 
행정적 걸림돌을 즉석에서 해결하는 속도감 있는 소통의 현장!

여러분의 꿈이 서류에 막히지 않도록, 중기부가 더 적극적으로 현장에 찾아가겠습니다! 🚀🤝

snippet.title: #댓글이벤트│콩쥐가 신데렐라를 한국에 초대하면 생기는 일(?)
snippet.description:
매일 집안일에 시달리던 동서양의 대표 고생 아이콘,
콩쥐와 신데렐라가 뭉쳤습니다.

답답한 유리구두와 호미는 과감히 던져버리고, 
편안한 꽃신과 한복으로 갈아입은 두 사람의 화려한 일탈이 시작됩니다. 

광화문 광장의 보랏빛 야경부터
경복궁에서의 인생 사진,
남산의 화려한 불빛까지
서울의 힙한 명소들을 제대로 즐기는 K-관광 나들이를 영상에 담았습니다.

우울했던 어제는 잊고,
동행축제와 함께 가장 빛나는 서울의 밤을 만끽하는
두 사람의 특별한 하루를 지금 바로 만나보세요.

📅 축제 기간: 2026. 04. 11. ~ 05. 10.
🔗 동행축제 홈페이지 : https://k-shoppingfesta.org/

📢 댓글 #이벤트
외국인 관광객에게 소개해주고 싶은 우리나라 관광지를 댓글로 추천해주세요!

🎁 추첨을 통해 커피 쿠폰을 선물로 드립니다! 
📌 이벤트 기간 : 5.04.(월) ~ 5.17.(일)
📌 이벤트 경품 : 커피 쿠폰 5명
📌 당첨자 발표 : 2026.5.20.(수)

✅ (완전중요) 참여 방법
1. 영상 좋아요와 채널 구독은 필수!
2. 댓글로 추천 장소 남기기!
3. 댓글 작성 후 아래 이벤트 참여 양식 작성 필수!
(https://forms.gle/P2NMbdd6J2tMhXnv9)

*본 콘텐츠는 이해를 돕기 위해 생성형 AI 기반으로 재구성된 영상입니다.

snippet.title: 시장이야, 성수동이야? ✨
snippet.description:
전주 남부시장 안에 이런 공간이 있을 거라고 상상이나 하셨나요? 😲
성수동 전시장 못지않게 트렌디한 이곳은
전통시장 현대화로 탄생한 '복합 문화 공간'입니다!

부안에서 활동하는 힙한 청년 팀 시고르 청춘의 감각적인 디자인부터, 
어르신들의 소중한 이야기가 담긴 특별한 티셔츠까지! 🎨👕 
로컬의 매력이 가득한 2층 '작당' 공간에서 전국의 반짝이는 아이디어를 확인해 보세요.

지금 전국 50개 지역 축제와 함께하는 2026 동행축제가 한창입니다!
이번 주말, 가까운 시장에서 우리 소상공인과 청년들의 열정을 직접 느껴보시는 건 어떨까요? 🤝🚀

📅 2026 동행축제 기간: 2026. 04. 11. ~ 05. 10.
🔗 동행축제 홈페이지 : https://k-shoppingfesta.org/

id.title: Apakah ini pasar atau Seongsu-dong? ✨
id.description:
Pernahkah Anda membayangkan ruang seperti ini ada di dalam Pasar Jeonju Nambu? 😲

Sama trendinya dengan ruang pameran di Seongsu-dong, tempat ini adalah 'ruang budaya kompleks' yang lahir dari modernisasi pasar tradisional!

Mulai dari desain bergaya Sigor Youth, tim pemuda gaul yang aktif di Buan, hingga kaos khusus yang menampilkan kisah-kisah berharga para lansia! 🎨👕

Lihat ide-ide brilian dari seluruh negeri di 'Jakdang' di lantai dua, sebuah ruang yang dipenuhi pesona lokal.

Festival Donghaeng 2026 saat ini sedang berlangsung meriah, menampilkan 50 festival regional di seluruh negeri!

Mengapa tidak mengunjungi pasar terdekat akhir pekan ini dan merasakan langsung semangat para pemilik usaha kecil dan pemuda kita? 🤝🚀

📅 Periode Festival Donghaeng 2026: 11 April 2026 – 10 Mei 2026

🔗 Situs Web Festival Donghaeng: https://k-shoppingfesta.org/

snippet.title: "중기부 장관 1일 수행비서?! 🏃‍♂️ 새벽 6시부터 통영·진주까지 현장 질주!"
snippet.description:
비 내리는 이른 아침, 장관님이 통영과 진주로 달려간 이유는? 🌧️🏃‍♂️

로컬 창업의 꿈이 피어나는 통영의 골목부터, 기업의 어려움을 해결하기 위한 진주의 현장까지!

특히 3월 26일 문을 연 '모두의 창업' 프로젝트를 통해 청년들의 반짝이는 아이디어가 실제 비즈니스가 될 수 있도록 중기부가 든든한 뒷배가 되어드릴게요! 🤝✨

현장에서 듣고, 현장에서 해결하는 속도감 있는 정책!
여러분의 목소리가 대한민국 경제의 지도가 됩니다. 🚀

id.title: "Menjadi asisten pribadi Menteri UKM dan Startup selama sehari?! 🏃‍♂️ Berpacu ke lokasi dari jam ...
id.description:
Mengapa Menteri bergegas ke Tongyeong dan Jinju di pagi buta yang hujan? 🌧️🏃‍♂️

Dari gang-gang Tongyeong tempat impian startup lokal berkembang, hingga lapangan di Jinju tempat upaya dilakukan untuk menyelesaikan tantangan perusahaan!

Kami telah mengabadikan perjalanan Menteri yang penuh warna melalui mata seorang sekretaris eksekutif satu hari.

Secara khusus, melalui proyek 'Startup untuk Semua' yang diluncurkan pada 26 Maret, Kementerian UKM dan Startup akan menjadi dukungan kuat Anda untuk membantu ide-ide cemerlang anak muda berubah menjadi bisnis nyata! 🤝✨

Kebijakan yang cepat tanggap yang mendengarkan lapangan dan menyelesaikan masalah di lapangan!

Suara Anda menjadi peta ekonomi Korea. 🚀

[Jadwal Utama Menteri Han Sung-sook]

en-US.title: "A one-day personal assistant to the Minister of SMEs and Startups?! 🏃‍♂️ Racing to the scene fro...
en-US.description:
Why did the Minister rush to Tongyeong and Jinju on a rainy early morning? 🌧️🏃‍♂️

From the alleys of Tongyeong where dreams of local startups are blooming, to the field in Jinju where efforts are being made to resolve corporate challenges!

We have captured the Minister's vivid journey through the eyes of a one-day executive secretary.

In particular, through the 'Startups for All' project launched on March 26, the Ministry of SMEs and Startups will be your strong backing to help young people's brilliant ideas turn into actual businesses! 🤝✨

Fast-paced policies that listen to the field and solve problems on the ground!

Your voices become the map of the Korean economy. 🚀

snippet.description:

id.title: 5 Kebijakan Terbaik Kementerian Usaha Kecil dan Menengah serta Startup yang Dipilih Langsung oleh...
id.description:
Ini adalah cuplikan dari upacara penghargaan 'Pertemuan Evaluasi Kebijakan Penghargaan Kinerja Khusus Pertama 2026 untuk Pejabat Publik,' yang diadakan pada 21 April 2026.

Pada pertemuan ini, 5 kebijakan unggulan Kementerian UKM dan Startup—yang dipilih berdasarkan pengalaman langsung masyarakat—dan tokoh-tokoh kunci yang memimpin pencapaian tersebut diberi penghargaan.

Tonton videonya untuk mendengarkan pidato penerimaan yang tulus dari para penerima penghargaan, yang telah bekerja tanpa lelah siang dan malam di lapangan.

[Pemenang Penghargaan untuk 5 Kebijakan Terbaik yang Dipilih Langsung oleh Publik]

Hadiah Utama

- Pejabat Cha Sang-hoon, Divisi Perlindungan Teknologi: Peningkatan Sistem Perlindungan Teknologi UKM melalui 'Sistem Penemuan Gaya Korea'

Penghargaan Keunggulan

- Pejabat Kim Geon-young, Divisi Perencanaan Strategi: Pengurangan dokumen aplikasi proyek dukungan sebesar 50% dan volume rencana bisnis sebesar 30%

- Pejabat Jeon Sang-yong, Gugus Tugas Saling Menguntungkan: Promosi Saling Menguntungkan

Penghargaan Dorongan

- Pejabat Choi Jeong-min, Divisi Kebijakan Startup: Peluncuran skala penuh 17 Pusat Dukungan Satu Atap Startup di seluruh negeri

- Pejabat Park Jun-hyeong, Divisi Teknologi Informasi: Pembukaan data publik dan data di lokasi untuk startup

Kementerian UKM dan Startup akan terus berhasil mengatasi masalah yang tertunda dan memberikan hasil nyata yang dapat dirasakan oleh publik.

en-US.title: Top 5 Ministry of SMEs and Startups Policies Selected Directly by the Public
en-US.description:
This is the scene from the awards ceremony for the '2026 1st Special Performance Award Policy Evaluation Meeting for Public Officials,' held on April 21, 2026.

At this meeting, the Ministry of SMEs and Startups' Top 5 outstanding policies—selected based on the direct experiences of the public—and the key figures who led these achievements were honored with awards.

Watch the video to hear the sincere acceptance speeches from the award winners, who worked tirelessly day and night on the ground.

[Award Winners for the Top 5 Policies Selected Directly by the Public]

Grand Prize

- Officer Cha Sang-hoon, Technology Protection Division: Advancement of the SME Technology Protection System through the 'Korean-style Discovery System'

Excellence Award

- Officer Kim Geon-young, Strategy Planning Division: Reduction of support project application documents by 50% and business plan volume by 30%

- Officer Jeon Sang-yong, Win-Win Payback TF: Promotion of Win-Win Payback

Encouragement Award

- Officer Choi Jeong-min, Startup Policy Division: Full-scale launch of 17 nationwide Startup One-Stop Support Centers

- Officer Park Jun-hyeong, Information Technology Division: Opening of public and on-site data to startups

The Ministry of SMEs and Startups will continue to successfully address pending issues and deliver tangible results that the public can experience.

#MinistryofSMEsandStartups #MSME #ExcellentPolicy #SpecialPerformanceAwardforCivilServants #PolicyEvaluationMeeting #ProactiveAdministration #TechnologyProtection #RegulatoryRelaxation #MutualGrowthPayback #StartupSupport #PublicDataOpenness #PublicSelectionBEST5

id.title: Tur Wisata Kawasan Komersial Lokal dan Diskusi Makan Siang di Tongyeong
id.description:
Pada hari Jumat, 17 April 2026, kami mengunjungi kawasan komersial global di sekitar Dongpirang di Tongyeong untuk memeriksa status terkini revitalisasi komersial lokal.

Sebagai contoh, sebuah bangunan tua yang direnovasi dan diubah menjadi ruang kerja-kunjungan (workcation), menunjukkan peningkatan penjualan seiring dengan peningkatan jumlah wisatawan.

Selama pertemuan di lokasi, kami juga membahas dukungan untuk startup lokal dan strategi untuk menanggapi pariwisata asing.

Ke depannya, dukungan untuk revitalisasi kawasan komersial guna menghidupkan kembali perekonomian lokal dijadwalkan akan diperluas lebih lanjut.

#Tongyeong #Dongpirang #RevitalisasiKomersial #StartupLokal #EkonomiLokal #Workcation

en-US.title: Tongyeong Local Business District Tour and Luncheon Meeting
en-US.description:
On Friday, April 17, 2026, we visited the glocal commercial district around Dongpirang in Tongyeong to inspect the current status of local commercial revitalization.

As an example of an old building being remodeled and transformed into a workcation space, sales are on the rise alongside the increase in tourists.

During the on-site meeting, we also discussed support for local startups and strategies to respond to foreign tourism.

Moving forward, support for commercial district revitalization to revive the local economy is scheduled to be further expanded.

#Tongyeong #Dongpirang #CommercialRevitalization #LocalStartups #LocalEconomy #Workcation
